observations.name: non_consumable_purchase
observations.assertion: A real internal-testing lifetime purchase was verified with HTTP 200 and access was observed as allowed, but exactly-once logical event counting was not captured.

observations.name: non_consumable_duplicate_restore
observations.assertion: Two owned-purchase submissions with an unchanged projection version were not captured.

observations.name: subscription_initial
observations.assertion: A real monthly purchase was restored with HTTP 200 and produced allowed access at projection version 13, but acknowledgement ordering was not independently captured.

observations.name: subscription_renewal
observations.assertion: Repeated active observations exist, but an authoritative period advance and single logical transition were not captured together.

observations.name: subscription_cancellation
observations.assertion: Cancellation was issued in Play Console, but the canceled-at-period-end allowed projection was not observed before accelerated expiration.

observations.name: subscription_expiration
observations.assertion: Authenticated RTDN processing appeared to change the monthly entitlement from allowed to denied with reason expired, but the required correlated request ID and single-transition evidence were not captured.

observations.name: subscription_grace
observations.assertion: A declined renewal entering grace with retained access was not observed.

observations.name: subscription_account_hold
observations.assertion: Account-hold denial and recovery were not observed.

observations.name: subscription_pause
observations.assertion: Pause denial and resume restoration were not observed.

observations.name: subscription_refund
observations.assertion: A lifetime-product refund was observed, but the required subscription refund was not captured.

observations.name: subscription_revocation
observations.assertion: Immediate subscription revocation denial was not observed.

observations.name: pending_purchase
observations.assertion: A slow test-card pending purchase was not observed.

observations.name: post_commit_acknowledgement
observations.assertion: The real-provider commit-before-acknowledgement ordering was not independently captured.

observations.name: invalid_purchase_token
observations.assertion: An intentionally invalid token returned provider_error; verification and webhook counters remained unchanged at 34 and 17, confirming no observation, entitlement, acknowledgement, or outbox write.

observations.name: wrong_application_binding
observations.assertion: A valid token submitted to a different application scope was not observed.

observations.name: wrong_product_binding
observations.assertion: A valid token with a mismatched claimed product was not observed.

observations.name: wrong_customer_binding
observations.assertion: A valid token with a mismatched opaque account binding was not observed.

observations.name: duplicate_notification
observations.assertion: Authenticated duplicate RTDN delivery and single inbox identity were not captured together.

observations.name: missed_notification_reconciliation
observations.assertion: A deliberately omitted RTDN followed by authoritative reconciliation was not observed.

webhook.assertion: The live production-shaped receiver accepted a valid signed event, rejected an exact-body mutation with invalid_signature, rejected a correctly signed event one hour outside its five-minute tolerance with invalid_timestamp, and durably classified an exact replay as duplicate after one inserted identity.
